verifications.claim: Arslanbek Makhmudov is a Russian-Canadian professional heavyweight boxer.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'from Mozdok, Russia and fights out of Montreal, Quebec, Canada'; R5: 'Birth Place Mozdok, Russia... residence Montreal, Quebec, Canada'; R6/R7: 'nationality Russia... residence Montreal, Quebec, Canada... birth place Mozdok, Russia'; R9: 'Russian heavyweight boxer based in Canada'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm Russian origin and Canadian residence/base, commonly described as Russian-Canadian heavyweight boxer.

verifications.claim: Arslanbek Makhmudov has a 21-2-0 record as of April 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Arslanbek Makhmudov (21-2, 19 KOs)'; R2: 'Makhmudov (21-2-0)'; R4: 'Arslanbek Makhmudov (21-2, 19 KOs)'
verifications.reasoning: Pre-fight sources around April 11, 2026 explicitly state 21-2-0 record; post-fight sources update to 21-3-0 but claim aligns with cited pre-fight context.

verifications.claim: Arslanbek Makhmudov has 19 wins by knockout as of April 2026.

verifications.evidence: R1: '21-2, 19 KOs'; R2: 'Wins by knockout: ... Makhmudov (19)'; R3: 'Makhmudov (21-3, 19 KOs)'
verifications.reasoning: Pre- and post-fight sources consistently state 19 KOs with 21 wins.
